title: Portuguese Stewed Cod
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Portugal, featuring cod as the main ingredient. This dish is perfect for a cold evening meal.

ingredients.name: 1 cup water
ingredients.notes: Or fish stock for added flavor

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the cod fillet, Portuguese stew, water, thyme, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 8-10 minutes, or until the cod is cooked through.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
